text: Igquma linyakaza okwamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukunganaki.
en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.

text: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka egaraji. Namanje akukho okwenzekayo.
en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.

text: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi zona, njengenjwayelo, aziwenzi.
en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.

text: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukufudumala kona kusacishiwe.
en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.

text: Izingubo bekufanele zingeniswe emahoreni edlule. Umoya omncane uvotele ukuthi zihlale ngaphandle.
en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.

text: Inyanga iqhamuka phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama ikude phezulu.
en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.

text: I-Friendly City ayikaze icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa manje isiyiyo.
en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.

text: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange ahlushwe yilanga emehlweni.
en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

text: Izicathulo zisemakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.
en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.

text: Uma uzohamba ngezinyawo, hamba manje. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngo-7 kuphela.
en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.

text: Ngikhohlwe futhi ukuvula i-electric blanket kusenesikhathi. Njalo nje. Ubusuku nobusuku.
en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.

text: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nombila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.
en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.

text: Amafu ambalwa afikile ezobukela. Nawo awagijimi.
en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.

text: Ukuhlwa kungena ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.
en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.

text: Amafu adlulisana ngenyanga. I-balcony ijabule ukulinda.
en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.

text: Inkungu yase-Midlands: i-privacy setting yasemaphandleni.
en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.

text: I-windpump yenza wonke umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayishayela ihlombe nje.
en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.

text: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Umoya yiwona ozithengele amathikithi.
en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.

text: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kumpunga okhanyayo saya kumpunga omnyama. Umbukiso uphelele lapho.
en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.

text: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wamafu, umgqomo ugcwele. YiLwesibili ebusuku, njengokujwayelekile.
en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.

text: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elengeziwe.
en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.

text: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusiculela ukuze silale, mahhala.
en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.

text: Ithafa lonke lifiphele, kungathi kwehliswe umbala. Izimvu zona zibalwa ngokufanayo noma kunjani.
en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.

text: Amafu ahlale kwaze kwahlwa, ukuze nje alethe umbala. UMsombuluko ubusikweleta lokho.
en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.

text: Intaba igqoke indwangu yayo yetafula uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.
en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.

text: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe zona seziliqedile iviki.
en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.

text: Ilanga, bese kuba namafu, bese liphuma futhi. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela lutho.
en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.

text: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kokubili kumpunga. Izibani ze-pier kuphela ezizamile.
en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.

text: Ilanga lenza i-admin lapha ngaphandle. Ukushisa bekungekho ku-package.
en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.

text: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungenzi i-refresh.
en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.

text: Isibhakabhaka esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kubanda sengathi usefrijini enombukwane omuhle.
en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.

text: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kukhona ukuthula kuphela.
en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.

text: I-windpump ayikholelwa ekushayiseni. Nenja nayo ayikholelwa.
en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.

text: Asikhulumi ngosuku lwanamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya.
en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.

text: Ilanga liphuze ukuphuma ekuseni. Kodwa bekukufanele ukulinda.
en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.

text: Phola, izintaba ziyabafura nje.
en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.

text: Amafulegi aqondile ngenxa yomoya, iwayini libanjwe liqinile. UMsombuluko ozolile lowo, ngokwe-deck.
en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.

text: Amafu ahlobisa ukushona kwelanga, ama-sprinkler anisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizenzela imvula yalo.
en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.

text: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela inkundla yekhilikithi kancane. Akekho ofaka i-appeal.
en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.

text: Lokho kukhanya okuncane kungumuntu owazi ukwenza ubusika: iqhugwane, umlilo, sekulungile.
en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.

text: I-sprinkler kuthiwa ingeyotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abame emanzini.
en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.

text: Idolobha lonke libe nesu elilodwa kulobu busuku. Sibheke nje sonke.
en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.

text: Yisikhathi sekhefu, umoya omncane wenza izinwele zabo bonke. Ngisho nothisha.
en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.

text: Ingxenye yezinkanyezi ingemuva kwamafu. Ama-fairy lights ayazibambela.
en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

text: Umoya omncane uhambisa intuthu emgwaqweni wonke. Bonke omakhelwane sebeyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.
en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.

text: EKapa emva kwemvula: konke kuhlanzekile, kuyakhanya, futhi kubanda impela.
en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.

text: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. Ubusuku bangoMgqibelo bunesigqi, kancane nje.
en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.

text: Amafu aphenduka aba-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.
en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.

text: Isibani sasesibayeni yilanga elishonayo kusihlwa namuhla. Izinkomo azikhonondi, ziyamukela.
en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.

text: Ifulegi libikezela isimo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: ngenani olwandle.
en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.

text: Amafu namuhla. Ama-vibes wona kukuwe.
en: Clouds today, vibes optional.

text: Kubanda impela namuhla. Amakhaza angena ngisho emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.
en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.

text: E-Lowveld ama-sundowner akusibo ubunethezeka. Angumuthi.
en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.

text: Indwangu yetafula yentaba isilungile, ilindele umsebenzi wakusasa.
en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.

text: Izinkomo sezisesibayeni ngaphambi kokuba kuphele imibala yokushona kwelanga. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.
en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
